name: two triangles joined by one link split into two communities
why: Triangles a-b-c and d-e-f, joined by c -> d. m = 7 undirected edges; degrees a, b, e, f are 2 and c, d are 3.

queries.why: Local moving (nodes in ID order, ties to the smallest label) gives {a,b,c}, {d}, {e,f} after one pass and {a,b,c}, {d,e,f} after the second; merging the two would lower Q. Q = 2 * (3/7 - (7/14)^2) = 6/7 - 1/2.
One community holds every edge and all the degree: 7/7 - 1 = 0. Labels are arbitrary integers.
{a,b,c,d} holds 4 edges and degree 10, {e,f} holds 1 edge and degree 4: 5/7 - (100 + 16)/196 = 24/196.
A partition must assign every node.
Each of the 6 pairs between {a,b} and {d,e,f} routes through c (and symmetrically d), out of (5*4)/2 = 10 pairs of other nodes.
a-c-d-e is the longest shortest path; (a,e) is the smallest of the four pairs at distance 3.
